_allEvents.comment: This is the title for the page that lists all events.
_singleDateFormat.comment: This is the format for displaying a single date event. It includes start date, start time, end time, and time zone name.
_multiDateFormat.comment: This is the format for displaying a multi-day event. It includes start date, start time, end date, end time, and time zone name.
_eventsPortalTitle.comment: The title displayed in the browser tab for the events listing page.
_searchPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder text for the search input field.
_searchAlt.comment: Alt text for the search icon.
_sortByTitle.comment: Title attribute for the sort dropdown.
_sortOptionAZ.comment: Option to sort events alphabetically A to Z.
_sortOptionZA.comment: Option to sort events alphabetically Z to A.
_sortOptionNewest.comment: Option to sort events by date, newest first.
_sortOptionOldest.comment: Option to sort events by date, oldest first.
_loadingEvents.comment: Shown while events are being loaded.
_noEvents.comment: Shown when no events are available.
noEventsMatchingSearch: Није пронађен ниједан догађај који одговара претрази.
_noEventsMatchingSearch.comment: Shown when no events match the search criteria.
errorLoadingEvents: Грешка при учитавању догађаја. Покушајте поново касније.
_errorLoadingEvents.comment: Error message shown when there's a problem loading events.
errorLoadingEventDetails: Грешка при учитавању догађаја. Покушајте поново касније.
_errorLoadingEventDetails.comment: Error message shown when there's a problem loading event details.
_detailsAndRegistration.comment: Text for the button that leads to the event details page.
_fullyBooked.comment: Label shown when an event is fully booked.
_noDescriptionAvailable.comment: Text shown when an event has no description.
_calendar.comment: Alt text for the calendar icon.
_eventRegistration.comment: This is the title for the event registration page.
_loadingForm.comment: Shown while the registration form is loading.
errorNoEventId: Грешка: Није наведен ниједан ID догађаја
_errorNoEventId.comment: Error message shown when no event ID is provided in the URL.
_eventNotFound.comment: Error message shown when the requested event cannot be found.
eventFullyBooked: Овај догађај је тренутно достигао свој капацитет. Проверите касније или контактирајте организатора догађаја за више информација.
_eventFullyBooked.comment: Message shown when an event is fully booked and registration is not possible.
formLoadError: Грешка при учитавању регистрационог обрасца. Покушајте поново касније.
_formLoadError.comment: Error message shown when there is a problem loading the registration form.
formNotAvailable: Регистрациони образац није доступан за овај догађај.
_formNotAvailable.comment: Message shown when an event does not have a registration form.
_home.comment: Text displayed next to the home icon in the header.
_selectLanguage.comment: Title attribute for the language selection dropdown.
_lang_zh-HK.comment: Language name for Chinese (Hong Kong S.A.R.).
registrationIntro: Попуните формулар испод да бисте се пријавили за овај догађај.
